records.title: Houthi attacks disrupt Saudi energy facilities, wound 73, authorities say
records.claim: Saudi authorities said operations at some energy facilities were halted after Houthi attacks; Reuters reported Brent near $98/bbl and U.S. crude near $93.65/bbl after the statement.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Houthi attacks disrupt Saudi energy facilities, wound 73, authorities say

records.boundary: Facility-level capacity loss and outage duration were not disclosed; price is an intraday Reuters snapshot, not settlement.

price_semantics.basis: Reuters-reported intraday futures snapshot after Saudi energy ministry statement

records.title: Dangote expects fuel shortages beyond Iran war as it spurs expansion
records.claim: Dangote refinery CEO said global fuel shortages could persist beyond the Iran war because of refinery damage, high utilization/deferred maintenance and the need to rebuild inventories; the refinery is at 700,000 bpd and targets 1.4 million bpd by 2029.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Dangote expects fuel shortages beyond Iran war as it spurs expansion

records.boundary: Management outlook is not an official global balance forecast; future expansion is not current supply.

records.title: Russia's Arctic LNG 2 seeks $1 billion in damages from South Korea's Hanwha
records.claim: Arctic LNG 2 is seeking about $1 billion over cancelled Arc7 LNG tanker contracts; Reuters said the 19.8 Mtpa project has delivered cargoes to end-users in China while sanctions complicated its tanker availability.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Russia's Arctic LNG 2 seeks $1 billion in damages from South Korea's Hanwha

records.boundary: Arbitration value is not equivalent to lost LNG output; no same-window monthly cargo volume was provided.

records.title: In Australia's shale patch, Americans bring money, tech and lessons learned
records.claim: Beetaloo delivered first gas; developers target up to 1,000 TJ/day potentially enough for two LNG trains, while industry estimates well costs must fall 40%-60% and major pipeline infrastructure is still required.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: In Australia's shale patch, Americans bring money, tech and lessons learned

records.boundary: Target production is not current output or committed LNG capacity; economics and timing remain unproven.

records.title: South Korea's power demand set to soar on AI boom as nation weighs expanding nuclear energy
records.claim: South Korea's energy minister said AI-related expansion could add 25-30 GW of power demand; the government is assessing more nuclear capacity and noted some load centers may need LNG plants.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: South Korea's power demand set to soar on AI boom as nation weighs expanding nuclear energy

records.boundary: Incremental power demand is not equivalent to LNG capacity or import demand; future generation mix is undecided.
